[attribute-base-tagset]
=== `@base-tagset` Base Tag Set Name

Which of the STS standard tag sets is the basis for this document?

#### Usage/Remarks
#### Related Attributes

Several attributes on the <<element-processing-meta,`<processing-meta>`>> element describe the tag set version choices more fully than the <<attribute-dtd-version,`@dtd-version`>> attribute alone: <<attribute-tagset-family,`@tagset-family`>> Which of the JATS tag set families is the basis for this document’s tag set? (e.g., “`sts`” or “`jats`”) <<attribute-base-tagset,`@base-tagset`>> Which of the STS standard tag sets is the basis for this document? (e.g., “`interchange`” or “`extended`”) <<attribute-table-model,`@table-model`>> Which table model is used by the tag set for this document? (e.g., “`xhtml`” or “`oasis`”) <<attribute-mathml-version,`@mathml-version`>> Which version of MathML is used by the tag set for this document? (e.g., “`3.0`” or “`2.0`”) <<attribute-terminology-model,`@terminology-model`>> Are the terms for this standard described by TBX or by <<element-term-display,`<term-display>`>>? <<attribute-math-representation,`@math-representation`>> A list of the (possibly many) ways mathematical expressions may be represented in this document (e.g., both MathML and TeX [“`mathml tex`”])

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-processing-meta,`<processing-meta>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| interchange| Interchange Tag Set — Basic STS Tag Set for interchange, using only XHTML tables.
| extended| The Extended Tag Set differs from the Interchange Tag Set in allowing OASIS Exchange
                        (CALS) tables in addition to XHTML tables.
| Restriction| `@base-tagset` is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Sample

##### An Interchange Tag Set
[source,xml]
....
<standard
  xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"
  xmlns:tbx="urn:iso:std:iso:30042:ed-1"
  xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"
  xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude"
  dtd-version="1.2"
  xml:lang="en">
 <processing-meta
   base-tagset="interchange"
   mathml-version="3.0"
   table-model="xhtml"
   terminology-model="term-display"
   math-representation="mathml png"
   tagset-family="sts" />  
 <front>...</front>
 <body>...</body>
 <back>...</back>
</standard>
....
